chunks: And when the stars are scattered
ai.seo_question: What does it mean when the stars are scattered in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah al-Takwir is interpreted not merely as physical destruction but as the dissolution of the cosmic order (nizam al-kawn) that sustains creation, marking the transition from the temporal world to the eternal realm. Scholars emphasize that the scattering of stars signifies the end of celestial governance, preparing the stage for the final reckoning where all hidden truths are revealed.
